metadata.description: JITX hardware design automation skills for PCB design, component modeling, and circuit creation

plugins.name: jitx-skills
plugins.description: JITX workflow skills for PCB design. Use jitx-component-modeler when user wants to: create a component, model a part, generate component code, add a component definition. Supports SOIC, QFN, BGA, SON, SOT packages with thermal pads and multi-unit symbols.
